cash_transactions_void_complete.name: cash_transactions_void_complete
cash_transactions_void_complete.value:
("cash_transactions"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "cash_transactions"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "cash_transactions"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("cash_transactions"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_transactions"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cash_transactions"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("cash_transactions"."void_reason") <> '')

qurban_groups_costs_positive.name: qurban_groups_costs_positive
qurban_groups_costs_positive.value:
"qurban_groups"."estimated_total" > 0
        AND ("qurban_groups"."final_total" IS NULL OR "qurban_groups"."final_total" > 0)
        AND ("qurban_groups"."purchase_cost" IS NULL OR "qurban_groups"."purchase_cost" > 0)

qurban_groups_ready_price_locked.name: qurban_groups_ready_price_locked
qurban_groups_ready_price_locked.value:
"qurban_groups"."status" NOT IN ('ready', 'purchased', 'slaughtered')
        OR "qurban_groups"."final_total" IS NOT NULL

qurban_groups_purchased_has_receipt.name: qurban_groups_purchased_has_receipt
qurban_groups_purchased_has_receipt.value:
"qurban_groups"."status" NOT IN ('purchased', 'slaughtered')
        OR "qurban_groups"."purchased_at" IS NOT NULL

qurban_registrations_cancellation_comple.name: qurban_registrations_cancellation_complete
qurban_registrations_cancellation_comple.value:
("qurban_registrations"."status" = 'active' AND "qurban_registrations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL
          AND "qurban_registrations"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "qurban_registrations"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("qurban_registrations"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "qurban_registrations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "qurban_registrations"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "qurban_registrations"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim("qurban_registrations"."cancellation_reason") <> '')
